headline: Bitcoin holds above $83k, testing key resistance as liquidity hunt eases
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming higher highs, holding the 83,200–83,300 demand zone; 4H shows a clean uptrend with the 82,800 support intact, targeting the 83,800 resistance.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into high‑beta assets; GNS, BAT, OP and AMP lead with strong upside, indicating capital shifting from BTC to risk‑on tokens.
strategy_outlook: Enter spot BTC longs near 82,800 with a tight stop at 82,500; on futures, consider buying 1‑2 % of account size on 10‑x leverage with a target at 83,800 and a stop at 82,800.
